purpose: Open a planned step's thread: name the step the model is executing, the results of the steps it depends on, and the tools its intent permits.

description.description: The step's description from the validated plan — the planner's own words, which is how a plan directs work.

dependency_results.description: Rendered by Python: a RESULTS OF EARLIER STEPS block listing each dependency's final answer, or an empty string when the step depends on nothing.

tools.description: The intent's approved tools, comma-separated, or 'none'.

expectations: The step's result as free text, ended by a declared finish_reason of stop (spec §11 contract 6).

metadata.change_reason: First version. The step framing is a user turn carrying this record's provenance on its row (spec §9), so contract 1's diff can name it as the one turn a plan adds.
